source.title: Bound semantic watcher goal-watchdog log tail read
source.objective: C2 semantic watcher reads the entire c2-roadmap-goal-watchdog.log every 15-second pass just to retain the last 35 lines. systemd currently reports about 223 MB memory peak per semantic-watcher pass. This is avoidable monitoring overhead and can become a self-inflicted resource bottleneck. Use a bounded tail/reverse read instead of Path.read_text().splitlines().
